name: Election Night
description: A full-screen board of live results for the 3 November 2026 House and Senate races, laid out like a broadcast board: party gains and seat counts toward a majority, a map of calls and flips, the next poll closing, a race desk that pages through every Senate race and the competitive House seats with who's likely to win as votes come in, a live feed of calls and election headlines from the last half hour, and the Chicago Board of Education president and District 6A.
author: Ryan

textScale.title: Text size
textScale.description: Text already grows with the module, sized to read across a room on a full 1080p screen. This makes everything larger or smaller from there; larger shows fewer races and headlines at a time.

pageSeconds.title: Turn the race list and feed every (seconds)

news.title: Election headlines in the live feed
news.description: From AP, CBS News, The New York Times, PBS and NPR.

celebrate.title: Celebrate every Democratic win
celebrate.description: Blue fireworks and confetti over the module when a race is called for a Democrat. Wins called in the same update share one celebration.

celebrateFlips.title: Celebrate Democratic flips
celebrateFlips.description: When Democrats take a seat the Republicans held: the banner turns from red to blue, then the confetti and fireworks start. Plays when it’s called; after that, the last three flips replay on the clock. Works on its own with the setting above turned off.

celebrateTimes.title: Play each win
celebrateTimes.description: How many times each Democratic win plays: the first when the race is called, the rest after the gap below. Flips replay on the clock instead.

celebrateControl.title: Celebrate Democratic control
celebrateControl.description: “Democrats win the Senate” or “…the House” once enough seats are called: 51 in the Senate (the vice president breaks ties for the GOP), 218 in the House. Plays when it happens, then on the clock.

replayEvery.title: Replay flips and control
replayEvery.description: After its first showing, “Democrats win the Senate/House” and the last three Democratic flips play again on the clock: every 10 minutes means :00, :10, :20 and so on.

schoolBoard.title: Chicago Board of Education
schoolBoard.description: The board president’s race and District 6A, from the Chicago Sun-Times’ AP results.
